findings: BLOCKER 1 - the frozen SourceConsumption sentence in PH-243 item 2 is exact but still conflicts with PH-239's permitted reclassification flow, so it is not directly usable as the canonical invariant. The frozen text says 'Each classified bank fact has exactly one original cash-book posting group ... no other posting may represent the same bank cash' and 'Cash allocation, reclassification bookkeeping and release create no AccountingEvent and no LedgerPosting', while PH-239 line 10 allows a new classification after a fully reversed one ('撤后允许重新分类，原分类与撤分类历史保留') and line 13 requires the re-classification to reuse the same bank_effect claim ('撤后重新分类复用同一 claim...才能新增'), i.e. a new effective classification creates a new original AccountingEvent + LedgerPosting group for the same bank cash. As written, the invariant forbids exactly the reclassification path PH-239 freezes (and 'no other posting may represent the same bank cash' is also over-broad relative to the allowed mirror reversal posting). Fix the frozen sentence (keeping the five points): (a) 'each EFFECTIVE classification has exactly one original cash-book posting group, and at any time at most one effective original group exists per bank fact'; (b) reversal appends the mirror reversal event/posting and never a second positive bank flow; (c) a new classification after a fully reversed one may append a NEW original group while reusing the same bank_effect claim, with no second concurrent group and no claim release/duplication; (d) allocation and release create no AccountingEvent/LedgerPosting (drop or precisely scope 'reclassification bookkeeping'); (e) retain the existing phrases and the eight-value consumer enum. Then update the PH-243 test to assert that exact text.
